name: Liaoningosaurus
sum: Liaoningosaurus is a small ankylosaur from the Yixian Formation of Liaoning, China, known from more than twenty juveniles and perhaps partly aquatic.
wsnote: Estimated length of the type specimen, a juvenile (cited Wikipedia revision); adult size unknown.
holotype: IVPP V12560, a nearly complete articulated skeleton about 34 cm long on a slab — Yixian Formation, Liaoning.
material: More than 20 specimens, all juveniles, including XHPM-1206.
biology: Some skeletal features may suggest a partly aquatic life; later work (Ji et al. 2016) reports fish-hunting from gut contents (cited revision).
author: Xu et al. 2001
